Canadian Museum of History.question: The hub features a large 15.5 by 9.5 metres (51 ft × 31 ft) image of _____ on the floor
Canadian Museum of History.fact: The hub features a large 15.5 by 9.5 metres (51 ft × 31 ft) image of Canada on the floor. The image of Canada is made up of 121 satellite photos taken by the Canadian Space Agency, that were stitched together to form a single image.
